Method of Attack: Contains an open-source info-stealer called TurkoRat
Exfiltrates sensitive developer source code and confidential information
Gathers OS username and current working directory
Searches for files with specific extensions or in specific directories
Creates ZIP archives of directories and uploads them to an FTP server
Impacted Systems: Developer systems, particularly in the cryptocurrency sector
Attack Vector: Execution of malicious code upon package installation via postinstall hook
